name: Running prefix sum + lowest point
whenToUse: The standard answer: one pass, no extra array. Only the lowest prefix sum matters, so it is kept in one variable.

card.signals: "step by step sum" from left to right = a running (prefix) sum. "never less than 1" = only the lowest of those sums matters.
card.pattern: a running prefix sum. One index i walks nums once; total holds nums[0] + … + nums[i], and lowest keeps the smallest total seen. O(n) time.
card.coreIdea: With startValue added, every step-by-step sum is startValue + total. The smallest of them is startValue + lowest, and it must be at least 1, so startValue = 1 − lowest. lowest starts at 0, so the answer is never below 1.
card.variant: running prefix sum, no array. Only one value of the prefix sums is needed (the lowest), so we keep total and lowest in two variables instead of a whole prefix array.

invariant: After step i: total = nums[0] + … + nums[i], and lowest = min(0, every total so far).
